articles.title: Man charged after sexual assaults on Richmond Hill hiking trail: York police
articles.summary: York regional police say a 30-year-old man has been charged in two sexual assaults on youth victims that occurred days apart in Richmond Hill.

articles.title: Flight attendants and pilots have highest risk of dying from radiation-linked cancers, study says
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Flight attendants and pilots are at the highest risk of dying from radiation-related cancers — even more than people who work with radioactive materials, according to a new study.

articles.summary: The family of a two‑year‑old girl who died after falling from a 19th‑floor apartment window in North York has launched a multi-million dollar lawsuit against the building’s owners and property managers, alleging years of ignored warnings, unsafe glass, and failures to maintain or upgrade windows that they say directly led to the child’s death. articles.title: Madonna leads 2026 MTV Video Music Awards nominations, followed by Taylor Swift
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Madonna leads the 2026 MTV Video Music Award nominations, the network announced Tuesday.

articles.title: Power being restored for thousands of Brampton homes and businesses after collision knocked down hydro poles
articles.summary: About 4,376 homes and businesses lost power for some time early Tuesday due to a single-vehicle collision that knocked down two hydro poles, the power company said.

articles.title: A year after her 8-year-old son was shot in his bed, a mother continues to fight against gun violence
articles.summary: After her son was struck and killed by a stray bullet while in their North York apartment, Holly Roy says she continues to carry him with her as she advocates against gun violence.

articles.title: Beaver sculptures that welcomed FIFA fans in Toronto up for auction
articles.summary: Hand-painted beaver statues representing different countries in the FIFA World Cup that were sprawled across the eastern downtown neighbourhood of Old Town Toronto are now up for auction.

articles.title: Oil spill westbound on Highway 401 past Keele caused problems but all lanes open now: OPP
articles.summary: An oil spill in the westbound lanes of Highway 401 past Keele Street caused "major problems" earlier Monday but all lanes have reopened, police say.

articles.title: 5 charged, including 2 youths, in fatal double shooting on Brampton school grounds
articles.summary: A 21-year-old and two 17-year-olds from Brampton are facing two charges each of first-degree murder, after a shooting on school grounds in Brampton that took the lives of one man and one youth in April, Peel police say.

articles.title: Mike Layton files bid for his old Toronto council seat in Ward 11
articles.summary: Former city councillor Mike Layton registered to run again in University-Rosedale, following a four-year hiatus from city hall.

articles.title: Police investigating after man dies in motorcycle collision in Vaughan
articles.summary: York Regional Police are investigating after a man died in hospital following a collision involving a motorcycle in Vaughan late Sunday night.
